subject: D-INTEG-01 ID-profile and FEM recover class
body:
TASK: D-INTEG-01 architecture notes
STATUS: CANDIDATE
CONFLICT_1: C SPEAR candidate_ref[31:24]!=0 -> INVALID (Arty subset) vs locked 32-bit semantic ID [S02/S33.2]. D will not shrink wire identity. High-zero is packing check not a new ID width.
CONFLICT_2: S11.12.3 names 3 recover states; D-INTEG-01 consumes COMMITTED_CORRUPT as 4th dest-domain class. Promotion of that name into S11 is A/C if required.
CONFLICT_3: C FEM T2 port is word-atomic; production persistence is T2 DDR/MIG. Word-atomic B0-B6 does not prove DDR crash safety.
MIG_APP_DATA_WIDTH: still UNKNOWN (no generated MIG).
PROGRAM=NO
